newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FTB owns 93 pct of M.C. Packaging, extends offer.
newsitem.headline: FTB owns 93 pct of M.C. Packaging, extends offer.

text.p: FTB Packaging Ltd, a unit of Ball Corp, said on Friday it held 92.80 percent of M.C. Packaging (Hong Kong) Ltd through direct and indirect holdings, and was extending its cash offer for the company.
The offer period, which was due to close on Thursday, has been extended to February 14. FTB offered HK$2.80 per share for M.C. Packaging shares.
FTB said it controlled 623.49 million shares directly and indirectly. A total 250.94 million shares, or 37.35 percent of M.C. Packaging's issued share capital, were submitted under the offer.
In addition, FTB bought 6.50 million M.C. Packaging shares and a 58.05 percent stake in Fung Shun Investment Co Ltd -- which owns 336 million M.C. Packaging shares -- from Lam Soon (Hong Kong) Ltd.
Parties acting in concert own 30.04 million shares, it said.
The terms and conditions of the offer will remain unchanged during the extended offer period, FTB Packaging said. M.C. Packaging shares were up HK$0.075 at HK$2.75 in early trade.
